technical.zh-CN: 官网将工业/人形机器人列为独立应用领域，产品组织为工业轴承、直线运动、汽车与维护保养；需从机器人应用页进一步对应型号。
technical.en: The official site lists industrial/humanoid robotics as an application and organizes bearings, linear motion, automotive and maintenance products. Exact models must be identified from robot-application pages.
